name: soft-key-goal
task: Grab the key, and after that get to the goal square if you can.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task commands reaching the goal ('get to the goal square'), but no hard clause makes it happen: the only goal clause is the soft Existence(at_goal), which forces nothing, and FINAL_STATES is empty. The 'if you can' wording is a feasibility hedge, not a preference cue about priority. Add a hard Existence(at_goal); with Precedence(has_key, at_goal) it correctly records the 'after grabbing the key' order and forces both events.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(has_key) hard and Existence(at_goal) hard with Precedence(has_key, at_goal) hard capture both required events and their order; the chain forces the key grab, and no redundant or added clauses are present.

texts: The agent grabs the key at least once.
The agent reaches the goal at least once.
The agent reaches the goal only after having grabbed the key.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u3
REJECTING_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_goal&has_key) -> u1
(u0, at_goal&!has_key) -> u2
(u0, at_goal&has_key) -> u3
(u1, at_goal) -> u3
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_goal&has_key, u1) -> 1
(u0, at_goal&!has_key, u2) -> -10
(u0, at_goal&has_key, u3) -> 12
(u1, at_goal, u3) -> 11
